classification_definitions.clinically-complete: not a global synonym, but a case-level complete and compatible label, including a correct more-specific diagnosis
classification_definitions.compatible-parent-component: a related parent, component, manifestation, or incompletely scoped label that does not preserve the full requested object
classification_definitions.exact-equivalent: established synonym or name variant preserving the same clinical entity without adding/removing a required disease-defining scope
classification_definitions.true-loss: no candidate in the affected arm is exact-equivalent or clinically complete for the frozen requested object
classification_definitions.unresolved: the frozen label/evidence is insufficient to distinguish a complete synonym from a manifestation or otherwise incomplete object
